notes.title: NEW Major update (Halloween 2018)
notes.notes:
Here it is! Ready for the 2018 Halloween!

A new MAJOR update for Jack and the Cat (formerly known as Just Die Neon)!

New visuals to match the Halloween spirit, B-movie horror theme and old film effects that will make you believe you are playing a cult classic horror movie from the 50s!

What's greater though is that now Jack and the Cat has gamepad support!
With no need to set anything, just make your choice from keyboard to gamepad on the fly!

Controls:

Jack
Left: A or Left stick (left)
Right: D or Left stick (right)
Jump: W or Left shoulder button

Cat
Left: Left arrow or Right stick (left)
Right: Right arrow or Right stick (right)
Jump: Up arrow  or Right shoulder button

Enjoy the new theme with the new control scheme!

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Due to the Halloween season, we are giving Just Die Neon a huge update!
All visuals and sounds are changing, making the game more kid friendly and Halloween themed. Now you have to control Jack (the pumpkinhead) to shed light to his cat so she can find her way to her favourite toy, the hanged skeleton. The light system have changed to more cartoonish, yet more realistic way, with a light circle following Jack all the way and cat will be vissible once inside it.
Bonus items integrated.
Point system changed. Now cat have to catch all fireflies on the stage to earn points (non mandatory).
There is no more level hub, so there can be no more retry for stages. Instead, the gameplay was configured the way old-school arcade were, from start to finish on one playthrough. 
We hope you enjoy it!
Happy Halloween!
